opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a permanent or fixed‑term position, based at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation, must have teaching and admin duties, and be able to lead interdisciplinary collaboration across Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Cross‑disciplinary research awards for established researchers to pursue interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven projects benefiting wider society.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher (any career stage) with prior public‑engagement experience; cannot have received a previous SHAPE award.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative public‑engagement projects with GLAM or performing‑arts partners, supporting researchers in the humanities and social sciences.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at a UK or German research institution.
opportunities.summary: Travel‑funded attendance at a three‑day interdisciplinary symposium on ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’. Includes seed‑funding for collaborative projects.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or recognised research organisation, holding a post‑doctoral position and not already in a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships supporting independent research leading to a significant publishable output, funded at 80 % of salary costs.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK higher‑education institution or independent research organisation, working in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Awards to develop quantitative, digital, language or other methodological skills, supporting skill acquisition, collaboration and dissemination.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators from the humanities or social sciences, with a post‑doctoral or higher position, collaborating with overseas partners and interdisciplinary co‑applicants.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year interdisciplinary projects on mobilities, encouraging collaboration across SHAPE and STEM disciplines.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, eligible for a one‑year fellowship hosted at DGAP in Berlin.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships to develop policy‑relevant analysis and networks across creative, cultural, public, private and policy sectors.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding (up to £4,000, with possible higher amounts) to support additional needs such as equipment, caring costs, or assistance with application preparation.
